claims.assertion: Mari says the Taygetan Alcyone-class battleship Asterope arrived near Earth on April 13, 2024, docking beside Toleka after a three-hour approach guided by Viera.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says large ships enter interplanetary space before approaching orbital traffic.

claims.assertion: Mari says Asterope and Alcyone are assigned fleet defense and a long-term social-media mission, with trained crew posing as starseeds to raise planetary consciousness.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says about 3,000 Taygetan applicants were waitlisted after failing to qualify.

coverage_gaps: missing Centauri pilots and rescue operation
